sliceagent.review:
Genuine issues found:

- `taskq/queue.py`: Mutable default argument `items=[]` causes all `TaskQueue` instances without an explicit `items` argument to share the same underlying list.
- `taskq/queue.py`: `is_full()` uses `len(self._items) > self.capacity` instead of `>=`, so the queue accepts one item beyond its stated capacity.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once()` opens the log file with `open(..., "a")` but never closes it, leaking file descriptors.
- `taskq/scheduler.py`: `run_with_retry()` initializes `attempts = 0` but never increments it, causing an infinite loop whenever a task fails or the queue is empty.
- `taskq/store.py`: `find_by_name()` builds SQL via `"... WHERE name = '%s'" % name`, making it vulnerable to SQL injection.
